final_rationale: The verdict does not change because no new admissible evidence was provided. The Actor usefully narrowed the claim and conceded the core evidentiary gaps, but that is a reinterpretation of the same record, not proof that the required policy predicates have been met. The distinction matters: a caveated certification path may be plausible if the packet is updated, but the current audit question is whether compliance is established now on available evidence. It is not. Current aggregate readiness and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support part of the release case, but the policy also requires current-release documentation to reflect current results and to disclose the material segment weakness unless covered by approved mitigation. Those predicates remain unproven, so the present record remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
